assigned.title: Playback telemetry
assigned.acceptance: Startup, rebuffer, quality switch, and failure events are observable with privacy redaction

typecheck.evidence: npx turbo run typecheck --force, exit 0, 21 of 21. NO CODE WAS WRITTEN FOR PL-0503 THIS ROUND. Its implementation is in committed history and this round performed the provenance repair the reviewer ratified: an evidence-based narrowing of allowedPaths from three wildcards to fourteen paths, then reconciliation to cb62234. The gate records that the delivered implementation typechecks at the integrated head.

unit.evidence: npx turbo run test --force, exit 0, 20 of 20, 2734 passed 1 skipped -- unchanged, because this round wrote no code for this task. The suites bearing on the acceptance are inside that total and are named rather than implied: packages/observability's cmcd-collect.test.ts, cmcd-collect.property.test.ts, cmcd-report.test.ts, cmcd-keys.test.ts and redaction.test.ts (68 tests in that package), apps/web's player telemetry.test.ts, and the api/v1/telemetry/cmcd handler and cmcd-sfv tests. Redaction is the acceptance's own word and redaction.test.ts is where it is exercised. AN UNREPRODUCIBLE FAILURE OCCURRED ON THE FIRST RUN AT THIS TREE AND IS RECORDED RATHER THAN DISCARDED. That run reported '@liberty/media-inspection:test: Tests 1 failed | 251 passed (252)' with 12 of 17 tasks successful. The isolated suite then passed 252 of 252, and a second full turbo run passed 20 of 20 with media-inspection at 252. I CANNOT NAME THE FAILING TEST: my command piped the output through a grep that kept only the summary lines, so the name was discarded before I read it. That is my error in capturing, not an absence of evidence, and it is stated plainly because this project has been burned by an unexplained failure before -- round 52's, which turned out to be concurrency-dependent rather than seed-dependent and produced PL-AI-0010's timeout config. THE STANDING HYPOTHESIS FITS AND IS NOT PROVEN: this machine has 2 cores, turbo's default concurrency is 10, and packages/media-inspection has NO vitest.config.ts of its own, so its suites -- including order.property.test.ts, a fast-check property suite -- run under vitest's 5000ms default. PL-AI-0010 fixed exactly this shape for packages/contracts and its fix was deliberately scoped to that package. media-inspection is therefore in the state contracts was in before round 52, and this observation is the second data point. It is NOT this task's surface and nothing was changed about it; it is reported in the handoff for a ruling on whether it wants a task. WHAT THIS GATE CLAIMS: the suites pass at this tree, observed twice after the one failure. WHAT IT DOES NOT CLAIM: that the failure was a flake. An unreproduced failure is unexplained, not benign, and calling it a flake is the reading that would bury it.

assigned.notes: EVIDENCE-BASED NARROWING 2026-09-22, under the procedure gpt-architect RATIFIED as general at b0344606887e4b91e1d832b7c082bb95059d151b, with its explicit caution that this is not permission to choose narrow paths merely to remove collisions. allowedPaths were ["apps/web/src/**","packages/observability/**","packages/contracts/**"]. THE SURFACE IS THE UNION OF WHAT THREE COMMITS WROTE, and none of them names PL-0503 alone, so every path is attributed by subject matter against the acceptance -- startup, rebuffer, quality switch and failure events observable WITH PRIVACY REDACTION. 4ca4313 'Preflight' created telemetry.ts and the observability telemetry set: cmcd-collect and its two tests, cmcd-keys, cmcd-report and its test, log-event, redaction and its test, and it edited index.ts. cf98b97 'PL-0503/PL-0504: the CMCD keys that reach the CDN' edited telemetry.ts and cmcd-keys and created their tests. 719d2d7 'Nine lanes' created apps/web/src/app/api/v1/telemetry/cmcd, the ingestion endpoint without which the events are not observable anywhere. THE SPLIT AGAINST PL-0504 IS THE DELICATE PART AND IT WAS DRAWN ON THE ACCEPTANCES, NOT ON CONVENIENCE. cf98b97 is a two-task commit -- its subject names both -- and its diagnostics half (av-continuity, frame-timing, video-hole, buffered-ranges, sequence-mode, readers) plus docs/AV_SYNC_MEASUREMENT.md answer PL-0504's acceptance about A/V continuity proxies and the flash-and-blip procedure, not this one. Those files are therefore NOT taken here even though PL-0503's old apps/web/src/** wildcard covered them and taking them would have been easier. packages/observability/src/index.ts IS INCLUDED AND PRE-EXISTS THE BASE: the bootstrap b484735 created the empty package with that barrel, and 4ca4313 edited it to export the telemetry set. It is a file this task genuinely wrote to, so the ruling says it stays, and the fact that it exists at the base is stated here rather than left for the reviewer to notice -- the base is where implementation began, not a point before every file's creation. reviewDependencies carries the diagnostics barrel that telemetry reads and the API contract document.
